Electronics & Precision PartsMetal FabricationStainless & Food EquipmentDeburringBlendingFinishing

Details

Non-woven wheels combine nylon fibre, resin and abrasive grain in an open structure. They remove burrs and blend marks while removing very little material, so tolerances are not affected. They run cool and give a uniform, repeatable finish.

FAQ

Do non-woven wheels change part dimensions?

Very little. They are made for finishing and light deburring rather than heavy stock removal.

Can you prepare supplier documents for electronics customers?

Yes. We have prepared supplier qualification documents for buyers in Taiwanese electronics supply chains.
